items.title: Gene Bertoncini interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: And he had written, the contractor thought, a very difficult part for me and Jay.

ctx.x: “Missouri Breaks” it was called. And he had written, the contractor thought, a very difficult part for me and Jay. It was like, you know the country group Flat and Scruggs? One of those real long country solos, in harmony you know. And so he got us the part the night before. And I was really grateful. Because John Williams — yeah I wish I’d even done a better job. John was great though. It really was marvelous.
Can you recall some of your favorite — out of that oh five to one thousand — things that you’ve played on. Is there any particular events that stand out?
